speaker: Sergeant Wynn
description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7 side quests, §5.9): Sergeant Wynn and three men who deserted Aldmere's war camp, hiding at the burned mill (quest.deserters). Spare them: their word for a parley (oath.crown.token_deserters - one of the herald's tokens, open to a stage-4 giant), the war camp's engines marked (world.aldmere.engines_marked: the war engines' errand appears in the journal and on the map) and 1 iron from their pay chest. Or hand them over to the war camp: 2 iron, and they are gone (their encounter forbids world.aldmere.deserters_handed). Either choice settles quest.deserters (world.aldmere.deserters_fate).

nodes.text: Don't - don't crush us, giant! We're no soldiers anymore. We ran from the war camp... Warlord Corvane hangs deserters.

choices.text: Who are you, and why did you run?
[Spare them] Go. The camp won't hear of you from me.
[Hand them over] The war camp will want its deserters back.

nodes.text: Sergeant Wynn, and these are my men. We built the camp's engines - we know where each one stands and where it comes apart - and we will not march them north to burn giants' halls. Spare us and I'll give you our word for the herald: deserters' word that you mean the crown's people no harm. I'll mark the engines for you too, and there's iron in our pay chest.

choices.text: [Spare them] Go, and keep your word.
[Hand them over] The war camp will want you back.

nodes.text: Thank you, giant. Tell Herald Maelis that Wynn vouches for you - she knows my name. And the engines: I've marked them for you, every one. Take the iron.
...So be it. The camp's quartermaster pays for deserters. Take your iron.
We'll be gone by morning. Good luck at the fort, giant - the herald will hear Wynn's word.
